result.summary: Several layout and content clipping issues: category chips, restaurant names, and a featured card are cut off, plus a likely truncated restaurant name.

issues.description: The last restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' row is clipped on the right, cutting off the image and the name 'Trattoria Piccol'.
issues.suggestion: Add right padding to the horizontal list and/or ensure the last card is fully visible, with a peek of the next item if intended.

issues.description: The bottom featured restaurant card is cut off by the tab bar, so the name, rating, and other details are not visible.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom content inset/padding so the last card sits fully above the navigation bar.

issues.description: The category chips row is clipped on the right (the next chip after 'Healthy' is only partially visible).
issues.suggestion: Allow horizontal scrolling with a clear peek of the next chip, or add end padding so the last visible chip isn't cut mid-shape.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Tokumaru Ramen' appears truncated as 'Tokumaru Ramer'.
issues.suggestion: Check the data source and text wrapping/ellipsis so the full name displays correctly.
